$comment: Documentation-only schema for assets/config/discovery_cards.json. Not enforced by a JSON-schema validator at build time — lib/models/discovery_card.dart's DiscoveryCard.fromJson performs the equivalent fail-fast validation at load time, and test/discovery_card_schema_test.dart asserts every card in the bundled asset satisfies it (including per-locale text completeness for the 5 production locales).

cards.id: string, must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)+$, stable and never reused
cards.category: one of: everydayLife, shopping, cooking, sports, aviation, truckingLogistics, healthcare, engineeringConstruction, artDesign, gaming, businessFinance
cards.sport: one of: cricket, football, basketball, americanFootball, baseball, tennis — required if and only if category == sports, otherwise must be omitted/null
cards.curriculumTags: array, zero or more of: gcseFoundation, gcseHigher, igcse
cards.illustrationAssetId: string, stable key resolved by DiscoveryIllustration; RC1 renders every id via an accessible category-based placeholder (see AccessibleIllustrationFallback) rather than requiring a bundled image file
cards.relatedDisciplineIds: array of category-name strings (own taxonomy, not curriculum tags) used to cross-link 'Where you'll use this' to disciplines without a dedicated RC1 card, e.g. engineeringConstruction/artDesign/gaming/businessFinance
cards.contentVersion: integer >= 1, bump whenever this card's text or answer changes

followUp.answerValue: number, program-readable and locale-invariant (the correct numeric answer to the follow-up question)
followUp.answerUnit: string or null, e.g. '%', 'km/h', 'L' — kept out of translated prose so grading never depends on locale text

<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.title: string
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.challengeQuestion: string, the question posed before Reveal
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.thinkPrompt: string, a short low-pressure prompt shown in the Think state
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.workedSteps: array of 2-5 strings, the deterministic step-by-step solution shown in Reveal
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.explanation: string, plain-language explanation of the underlying concept
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.followUpQuestion: string, one practice question reusing the same concept with different numbers
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.followUpAnswerText: string, the worked answer to the follow-up (prose form of followUp.answerValue/answerUnit)
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.illustrationAlt: string, screen-reader description of the (placeholder or future) illustration
